values.meaning: bonus magic damage on Q per stack
values.quote: Deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|25 to 55|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.

values.meaning: bonus magic damage on W explosion per stack
values.quote: Explosions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|55% of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.

values.meaning: bonus magic damage per E attack per stack
values.quote: Attacks each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|8 to 12.8|0 to 4.8|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
values.binNote: The 0.6 crit-scaling coefficient (0.6 x critChance x (critDamage-1)) is a hardcoded literal inside the SmolderP#EBonusDamage calculation, not exposed as its own named SmolderP data value (unlike QCritRatio for Q); the wiki's 8 to 12.8 / 0 to 4.8 crit range confirms this constant matches.

mechanics.claim: Smolder gains a stack of Dragon Practice each time he hits an enemy champion with an ability.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|''Dragon Practice''|buzzword3}} each time he hits an enemy champion with an {{tip|ability}}

mechanics.claim: Super Scorcher Breath (Q) also grants a stack whenever it kills a minion or monster.
mechanics.quote: whenever ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}

mechanics.claim: Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack if the target dies while the initial missile is in flight, and can grant an additional stack if the target then dies to the burn, for up to 2 stacks from one cast.
mechanics.quote:
{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}} grants a stack if the target dies while the initial missile is in flight.
** This happens even if the target dies to {{ais|Super Scorcher Breath 3|Smolder|Super Scorcher Breath}} burn, giving him a total of 2 stacks.

mechanics.claim: Achooo! (W) can only grant one stack of Dragon Practice per enemy champion, from its first hit against that target.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Achooo!|Smolder}} can only grant a stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} with the first hit against each enemy champion.

mechanics.claim: Flap, Flap, Flap (E) can only grant one stack of Dragon Practice per cast, regardless of how many attacks land.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Flap, Flap, Flap|Smolder}} can only grant one stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} per cast.
